channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Andre Drummond | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Andre Drummond from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Jalen Brunson on Andre Drummond, Mitchell Robinson
item.description:
Jalen Brunson on Mitchell Robinson:

“Obviously, Mitch was near and dear to all our hearts. I think the best part about the situation Andre Drummond is in, he’s not coming in to be Mitch, he’s coming in to be himself. We got to give him the confidence to go out there and be himself. This is a new team, this is a new journey, so everything for us is going to be new and we’re going to attack it every day. We put everyone in the position to be successful and just give each other confidence and encouragement.”

Jalen Brunson on Andre Drummond, Mitchell Robinson, Oct 1, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Billy Donovan on Andre Drummond
item.description:
Bulls head coachBilly Donovan on Andre Drummond:

“I loved him. He’s a great guy. I think by far as good of a rebounder as I’ve ever been around. Great team guy… Just a really, really good, good guy. I loved being around him.”

Billy Donovan on Andre Drummond, Dec 8, 2024. Source: Bluesky.

item.title: Chet Holmgren on Andre Drummond
item.description:
“I got stripped by [Andre] Drummond and then he made me fall on the fast break, in my first game… I was so salty after the game too.”

Chet Holmgren on Andre Drummond, Aug 20, 2024. Source: Twitter.

item.title: Alex Caruso on Nikola Vucevic, Andre Drummond
item.description:
“The starting lineup has changed, so there are groupings that just haven’t played a lot of minutes together.“That’s why you see us do a little more with the ‘Jumbo Lineup’ with Drum [Andre Drummond] and Vooch [Nikola Vucevic] just because putting two bigs in there covers up a lot of our interior weaknesses. Some of it is time together and the other part is just matchups. Orlando finished the game [Saturday] with four 6-9, 6-10 guys. We don’t have a lineup right now that can match that. A lot of the NBA is matchup and being able to compete through stuff because a lot of stuff is going to be out of your control. You just got to go with the flow.”

Alex Caruso on Nikola Vucevic, Andre Drummond, Feb 13, 2024. Source: Chicago Sun-Times.

item.title: Doc Rivers on Andre Drummond
item.description:
Omari Sanfoka II:Doc Rivers on Andre Drummond:

“He's been great. He's been one of those guys that guys love. He's been a great light. I'm pushing him, I told him 'I'm not going to just let you be you.' That's part of what I have to do and he's been great at it. He's allowed it.”

Doc Rivers on Andre Drummond, Oct 15, 2021. Source: Twitter @omarisankofa.

item.title: Joel Embiid on Andre Drummond
item.description:
Lauren Rosen:Joel Embiid on his early partnership with Andre Drummond:

“He’s a great guy. Obviously I always kicked his butt, and he knows it too. But it’s great to be in the same side. He’s a smart basketball player. I have a lot of respect for him. I think he’s going to be huge for us.”

Joel Embiid on Andre Drummond, Oct 13, 2021. Source: Twitter @LaurenMRosen.

item.title: Robert Williams on Andre Drummond
item.description:
Robert Williams says he focused on adding some muscle this offseason.

“They got Andre Drummond over there with the 76ers, man. I needed some meat on my bones.”

Robert Williams on Andre Drummond, Sep 27, 2021. Source: Twitter @chrisgrenham.

item.title: Doc Rivers on Andre Drummond
item.description:
Doc on Andre Drummond in an in-game interview with NBATV:

“I think it's a great place for him. Obviously, I'm biased, but having him and Joel, just think of that. Joel goes off the floor, Drummond comes on the floor. We’re gonna be protective of Joel so in the games Joel misses, we’re gonna have Andre Drummond starting in those games. That’s gonna make us all feel good all the time.”

Doc Rivers on Andre Drummond, Aug 9, 2021. Source: Twitter @Ky_Carlin.

item.title: Frank Vogel on Andre Drummond
item.description:
Lakers coachFrank Vogel on Andre Drummond:

“Dre was great for us. We’re hopeful that he’s a Laker for a long time. He really played well for us and was a good culture fit. He fit in well with the guys and was very well-liked.”

Frank Vogel on Andre Drummond, Jun 4, 2021. Source: Twitter @MikeAScotto.

item.title: Frank Vogel on Andre Drummond
item.description:
Ryan Ward:Frank Vogel on Andre Drummond:

“He's not quite where we want him to be yet, but that's part of adding a guy midseason.”

Frank Vogel on Andre Drummond, May 5, 2021. Source: Twitter @RyanWardLA.

item.title: Anthony Davis on Andre Drummond
item.description:
Ryan Ward:Anthony Davis on Andre Drummond:

“We're both guys that want to learn from each other and want to win. ... I think he's a great fit for us.”

Anthony Davis on Andre Drummond, Apr 21, 2021. Source: Twitter @RyanWardLA.

item.title: Frank Vogel on Andre Drummond
item.description:
“We need to get [Drummond] a ton of minutes to get him acclimated to our system with only X amount of games before the playoffs, and he'll be our starter. ... [Gasol's performance] doesn't change that.”

Frank Vogel on Andre Drummond, Apr 7, 2021. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Dwane Casey on Andre Drummond
item.description:
James Edwards III:Dwane Casey on Andre Drummond:

“I think he'll be a big help to the Lakers with his size and athleticism. ... Andre is a smart guy. He'll fit in. He'll know the system.”

Dwane Casey on Andre Drummond, Apr 1, 2021. Source: Twitter @JLEdwardsIII.

item.title: Frank Vogel on Andre Drummond
item.description:
Ryan Ward:Frank Vogel on if Andre Drummond has min restriction:

“No. He's going to play starter mins. ... He says he feels really good.”

Frank Vogel on Andre Drummond, Mar 31, 2021. Source: Twitter @RyanWardLA.

item.title: Frank Vogel on Andre Drummond
item.description:
Mike Trudell:Frank Vogel on Drummond’s first practice:

“He looked great. I think our group felt an uptick in energy - someone we know who can help us.”

Frank Vogel on Andre Drummond, Mar 30, 2021. Source: Twitter @LakersReporter.

item.title: Montrezl Harrell on Andre Drummond
item.description:
Montrezl Harrell on Andre Drummond:

“He's a strong solid player on both sides of the floor. ... We can't wait for him to get here. We're going to welcome him with open arms.”

Montrezl Harrell on Andre Drummond, Mar 29, 2021. Source: Twitter @RyanWardLA.

item.title: Rob Pelinka on Andre Drummond
item.description:
It became official soon after, the Lakers releasing a statement an hour before their game Sunday night against the Orlando Magic.

“Andre Drummond gives us powerful, anchor-point skills on both ends of the court,”

Rob Pelinka on Andre Drummond, Mar 29, 2021. Source: Los Angeles Times.

item.title: Julius Randle on Andre Drummond
item.description:
“Drummond plays close to the rim, so you’re limiting what Randle can do. Long-term, it doesn’t make a lot of sense to me.”

Julius Randle on Andre Drummond, Mar 16, 2021. Source: SportsNet New York.

item.title: Christian Wood on Blake Griffin, Andre Drummond
item.description:
After the All-Star break, Wood took it to another level, averaging 24.0 points, 9.6 rebounds and 1.0 block per game before the pandemic ended the Pistons’ season on March 11.Wood credits Casey for his breakthrough season.

“He’s always trusted me. I was always playing behind Andre Drummond and Blake Griffin at the time. But [Casey] would say, ‘This kid is talented. We just got to give him an opportunity in the system and get him right.’ And that’s what he did,”

Christian Wood on Blake Griffin, Andre Drummond, Jan 6, 2021. Source: The Undefeated.

item.title: Dwane Casey on Dennis Rodman, Andre Drummond
item.description:
Rod Beard:#Pistons Dwane Casey on Andre Drummond:

“He's the Dennis Rodman of our day as far as rebounding. He has a knack for rebounding...his future is going to be bright in this league.”

Dwane Casey on Dennis Rodman, Andre Drummond, Dec 26, 2020. Source: Twitter @detnewsRodBeard.

item.title: Dwane Casey on Tom Gores, Andre Drummond
item.description:
Dwane Casey on the Andre Drummond trade:

“It was as much of a business decision as anything else. The direction we were going in, the direction he needed to go in from an individual standpoint. I know Tom (Gores) loved Andre, our whole organization loved Andre.”

Dwane Casey on Tom Gores, Andre Drummond, Dec 26, 2020. Source: Twitter @omarisankofa.

item.title: Kevin Love on Andre Drummond
item.description:
Rick Noland:Love on playing with Drummond:

“The adjustment period for him had to be so vast. We didn't really get any time to play together and figure each other out, how we were going to work. That's the great thing is we are going to be able to start fresh.”

Kevin Love on Andre Drummond, Dec 3, 2020. Source: Twitter @RickNoland.

item.title: Kevin Love on Andre Drummond
item.description:
Rick Noland:More Love on Drummond:

“Us getting out there and having time together is going to be paramount, especially early on.”

Kevin Love on Andre Drummond, Dec 3, 2020. Source: Twitter @RickNoland.

item.title: Koby Altman on Andre Drummond
item.description:
“Obviously, he has a player option that if he picks up, we think we're in good shape in terms of our cap space. There's no better money spent than on Andre Drummond if he picks up his option.”

Koby Altman on Andre Drummond, Feb 19, 2020. Source: Bleacher Report.

item.title: John Beilein on Andre Drummond
item.description:
Chris Fedor:#Cavs John Beilein on new arrival Andre Drummond taking 3s:

“It hasn’t come up for discussion yet, but I think that it’s something that we’ll talk (about) with him. It’ll be one I think we have to sit and talk about.”

John Beilein on Andre Drummond, Feb 11, 2020. Source: Twitter @ChrisFedor.

item.title: Dwane Casey on Andre Drummond
item.description:
Vincent Ellis:Dwane Casey on Andre Drummond full-court rushes:

“For all you analytical people, the numbers are good. We remember the one time he goes and tries to drive through the entire team - and I remember it.”

Dwane Casey on Andre Drummond, Nov 6, 2019. Source: Twitter @Vincent_Ellis56.

item.title: Ed Stefanski on Andre Drummond
item.description:
#Pistons Ed Stefanski on Andre Drummond extension talks:

“We really like Andre -- the person and the player -- but you never know what's going to happen.”

Ed Stefanski on Andre Drummond, Sep 30, 2019. Source: Twitter @detnewsRodBeard.

item.title: Dwane Casey on Andre Drummond
item.description:
Dwane Casey on Andre Drummond’s (likely) upcoming free agency:

“Andre understands and knows who he is, what he means to us, how important he is to our program, where he is in his career, where he stands in the league. I try to stay out of the contract part of it. I’m there for him. My thing is, I want every one of our players to be rewarded, but the only way you’re rewarded in this league is by winning. I look back to Toronto and see Kyle Lowry with $100 million or whatever it was. That’s the same conversation I had with (Lowry). I hope that (Drummond) gets every penny that is coming to him, but the only way we accomplish that together is through winning. … That’s the basics of contract talks. I don’t get into that other stuff.”

Dwane Casey on Andre Drummond, Sep 26, 2019. Source: The Athletic.

item.title: Dwane Casey on Reggie Jackson, Andre Drummond
item.description:
“I think we’re gonna get a great season out of Reggie Jackson, a great year out of Andre Drummond,”

Dwane Casey on Reggie Jackson, Andre Drummond, Sep 2, 2019. Source: Clutch Points.

item.title: Thon Maker on Andre Drummond
item.description:
Thon Maker:

“It helps us as a team. You see Andre (Drummond) doing that, grabbing and going. It’s not grab and go, and necessarily go finish it. If you have the lane, go ahead and finish it, but more to get the offensive moving, get everybody running. You see Andre does it a lot. He’ll come down, get it out to the shooters on the wings, and it’s so dangerous; it’s hard to stop. The offence is flowing, everybody’s spreading, nobody’s waiting and clogging on the lane. They want me to get better in that area.”

Thon Maker on Andre Drummond, Aug 29, 2019. Source: FOXSports.com.
